items.title: Barry Kernfeld interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 16, 2020
items.q: I think Mingus made a comment along that line once, though I don't remember exactly what it was.

ctx.x: I think — books I haven’t written — I think jazz would do very well to have a book about jazz as performance practice by analogy with Baroque music performance practice. I think there are a huge amount of unspoken agreed conventions in a jazz performance and these are brought to the table when people meet and this is why you have the jazz show go “Let me introduce the band” and then they introduce each other because it’s the first time they’ve played together, and yet they sound great and the person who is not a…
I saw it. I think “You have to improvise on something.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
